issues.description: Indentation bug: registration block placed inside Math_unary class body
issues.detail: In mathdecl.py, the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block appears at module level but the diff shows the blank line before `@infer_global(math.atan2)` removed, suggesting the conditional may end up associated with the class. Verify it lives at module scope, not inside the class.

mathdecl.py uses `sys.version_info`, mathimpl.py files use `sys.version_info`, but the test uses `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION`. Numba already centralizes Python version detection via PYVERSION; the new code should use it everywhere for consistency and to align with project conventions.

issues.description: Missing `import sys` in mathimpl.py files (or unverified)
issues.detail: Both `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` now reference `sys.version_info` but the diff does not show a `sys` import being added. If sys is not already imported in those modules, this will NameError at import time on all Python versions.

issues.description: Python version gate unnecessary; could support exp2 on all versions
issues.detail: `math.exp2` is only a Python 3.11+ stdlib function, but Numba could implement it via `2**x` or directly via llvm.exp2 on older Pythons by registering against a Numba-defined symbol. Gating excludes 3.10 users. At minimum, document why the gate exists; ideally support all supported Python versions.

issues.description: Release notes file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a newline (`\ No newline at end of file`). Add a trailing newline for POSIX compliance and consistency with other rst files.

issues.description: Test values do not exercise exp2-specific behavior
issues.detail: test_exp2 uses the same x_values as test_exp (`[-2,-1,-2,2,1,2,.1,.2]`). Including integer powers like 0, 10, 53 (mantissa boundary), and negative values that exercise exp2's exactness for integer inputs would catch bugs that exp's test values would not.

review.summary: The PR adds `math.exp2` support cleanly by mirroring the existing `math.exp` pattern with LLVM intrinsic `llvm.exp2`. Main concerns: the version-gating mechanism is inconsistent (sys.version_info vs PYVERSION), the mathimpl.py files reference `sys` without a visible import in the diff, and the indentation of the mathdecl.py conditional needs verification to ensure it's at module scope. The release note is missing a trailing newline and test inputs could better exercise exp2-specific edge cases. Overall a small, sensible feature add but needs cleanup before merge.
